generated_blocks.interpretation: actual hypothesis blocks parsed (the nested instantiation_attempts[].hypothesis_attribution arrays, aggregated over every operator result)

generated_candidates.interpretation: assembled candidate count (the space's own generated counter)

distinct_mechanisms.interpretation: DISTINCT verdicts only — the distinctness instrument's own count

indeterminate.interpretation: retained for investigation, NOT counted as proven distinct

grounded_candidates.interpretation: valid evidence binding (grounded=True, record id + span resolved) AND the canonical support verdict

admissible_survivors.interpretation: passed the R138 admission gates (the lifecycle's discovery_admissible flag)

ungrounded_hypotheses.interpretation: retained explicitly-ungrounded hypotheses (enrichment required; NEVER admission)

ATTACK.interpretation: exact candidate-to-stage record join (the stage record NAMES the candidate; never a substring scan)
